categories.main_business_segments: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China (AMEC) primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end semiconductor equipment including plasma etching equipment, thin film deposition equipment, and MOCVD equipment. The company also develops equipment for integrated circuits, advanced packaging, LED epitaxial wafer production, power devices, MEMS manufacturing, and other microfabrication processes. Additionally, it operates subsidiaries focusing on semiconductor equipment manufacturing, technology services, and investment management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AMEC's core technologies include advanced plasma etching (CCP and ICP), thin film chemical vapor deposition (CVD, LPCVD, ALD), and metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) for compound semiconductors. The company emphasizes proprietary dual-chamber designs, adjustable electrode spacing, and high deep-to-width ratio etching capabilities. It employs a matrix management R&D model with specialized teams for mechanical design, process development, and software engineering. The company also capitalizes on extensive patent portfolios and continuous innovation in semiconductor microfabrication.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global semiconductor manufacturers producing integrated circuits, LED epitaxial wafers, power devices, MEMS, and advanced packaging. Key customers include top-tier logic and memory chip producers, LED display manufacturers, and power semiconductor fabricators. The products are used in advanced chip manufacturing nodes from 65nm down to 5nm and below, as well as in emerging markets like Micro-LED, high-end displays, and third-generation semiconductors such as GaN and SiC power devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: AMEC operates primarily in China with production and R&D bases in Shanghai, Nanchang, Guangzhou, and Chengdu. It has subsidiaries and sales offices in Singapore, Japan, the United States, and South Korea, supporting global sales and service. The company’s main revenue is generated from the Chinese mainland market, with growing international customer engagement in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: AMEC operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying semiconductor fabrication equipment and related process solutions. It provides critical tools for wafer processing steps such as etching, thin film deposition, and epitaxial growth, enabling chip manufacturers to produce advanced semiconductor devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-intensity R&D investment, dedicating over 27% of revenue to research and development, focusing on advancing etching and deposition technologies for logic and memory chips at advanced nodes. It is developing next-generation equipment for 5nm and below logic chips, ultra-high aspect ratio etching for 3D NAND, and expanding MOCVD capabilities for GaN and SiC power devices. AMEC also invests in digital transformation, industrial internet platforms, and environmental sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: AMEC generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment including etching machines, MOCVD systems, and thin film deposition tools. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts, equipment-related services, and technical support. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with some regional agency sales, especially in Europe.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AMEC is positioned as a leading domestic Chinese semiconductor equipment manufacturer with growing international presence. It competes against established global players from the US, Europe, and Japan in plasma etching, thin film deposition, and MOCVD equipment markets. The company holds a strong market share in China and is recognized as a top supplier of GaN-based LED MOCVD equipment globally. It is expanding into emerging segments like semiconductor metrology and inspection equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, AMEC reported revenue of approximately RMB 9.07 billion, a 44.73% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by a 54.72% growth in etching equipment sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.62 billion, slightly down by 9.53% due to increased R&D expenses. The company’s total assets grew 21.8% to RMB 26.22 billion, with net assets increasing 10.72% to RMB 19.74 billion. R&D investment nearly doubled to RMB 2.45 billion, reflecting a strong growth and innovation trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AMEC emphasizes technological innovation, product differentiation, and intellectual property protection to deliver advanced semiconductor fabrication equipment that meets the stringent requirements of cutting-edge chip manufacturing. Its products feature proprietary designs such as dual-chamber reactors, adjustable electrode spacing, and ultra-high aspect ratio etching capabilities, enabling superior process control and efficiency. The company’s close collaboration with leading customers and high R&D intensity ensure rapid adaptation to evolving semiconductor process needs, providing competitive performance and cost advantages.
